title: Yummy Cajun Mediterranean Couscous Sushi
description: A plant-based, Mediterranean-inspired sushi made with spiced couscous and fresh pickled vegetables.
instructions: Bring vegetable broth to a rolling boil in a saucepan.
Remove from heat, stir in couscous, cover, and let rest for 5 minutes.
Fluff couscous with a fork, then stir in olive oil, Cajun seasoning, lemon juice, and chopped parsley.
Let the mixture cool to room temperature.
Place a thin layer of cooled couscous on parchment paper and press firmly with a rolling pin to form a 6 inch square.
Cut the square into 6 equal rectangles with a sharp knife.
Lay a rectangle of couscous, top with a spoonful of roasted bell pepper, a slice of pickled cucumber, and a sprinkle of capers, then roll tightly using the parchment paper.
Slice the roll into 6 bite-size pieces and arrange on a platter; optionally drizzle with extra olive oil and a squeeze of lemon.
